```{r setup_opts, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, error = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")
cap = new_caption_counter()
has_rankings = length(rank_dat$trait_list) > 0
reference_check = rank_dat$reference_tech[1]
lab = list(option = option, options = options, participant = participant,
           participants = participants, reference_trait = reference_trait)
```

```{r summary, results='asis'}
heading(tr("h_summary"))

mon = monitoring
para(tr("sum_participants", n_registered = mon$registered, participants = participants,
        n_ref = if (has_rankings) sum(rank_dat$trait_list[[rank_dat$reference_trait_index]]$keep) else 0,
        reference_trait = reference_trait))

if (!has_rankings) {
  para(tr("sum_no_rankings"))
} else {
  para(tr("sum_items", n_items = ntechnologies, options = options,
          participant = participant, n_per = noptions))

  res = release$summary
  if (is.data.frame(res) && nrow(res) > 0) {
    top = head(res$item[order(-res$prob_beats_check)], 3)
    para(tr("sum_best", options = options, reference_trait = reference_trait,
            best = join_words(top)))
    better = res$item[!res$item_is_check & !is.na(res$p_value) & res$p_value < 0.05 &
                        res$prob_beats_check > 0.5]
    if (length(better) > 0) {
      para(tr("sum_check", n = length(better), options = options, check = reference_check,
              items = join_words(better)))
    } else {
      para(tr("sum_check_none", option = option, check = reference_check))
    }
  }

  if (length(rank_dat$trait_dropped) > 0) {
    para(tr("sum_dropped", n = length(rank_dat$trait_dropped),
            traits = join_words(rank_dat$trait_dropped)))
  }

  if (isTRUE(group_analysis$requested)) {
    para(tr("sum_groups", section = tr("h_groups")))
  }
}
```

```{r intro, results='asis'}
heading(tr("h_intro"))
para(tr("intro_p1", project = project_name),
     tr("intro_p2"), tr("intro_p3"), tr("intro_p4"), tr("intro_p5"))

heading(tr("h_expect"))
para(tr("expect_p1"))
cat(paste0("- ", c(tr("expect_li1"), tr("expect_li2"), tr("expect_li3"),
                   tr("expect_li4"), tr("expect_li5")), "\n"), sep = "")
cat("\n")
para(tr("expect_p2"))
```

```{r monitoring, results='asis'}
heading(tr("h_monitoring"))
para(tr("mon_intro", participants = participants))

att = monitoring$attrition
if (is.data.frame(att) && nrow(att) > 0) {
  all = att[att$group == "all", ]
  last = all[nrow(all), ]
  para(tr("mon_attrition_text", n_reg = monitoring$registered, participants = participants,
          n_last = last$n, pct_last = last$percent_of_registered, last = last$moment,
          k = cap$next_tab(), f = cap$next_fig()))
  tb = att[, c("group", "moment", "day", "n", "percent_of_registered", "lost_since_previous")]
  tb$group[tb$group == "all"] = tr("whole_group")
  if (length(unique(tb$group)) == 1) tb$group = NULL
  keys = c(if (!is.null(tb$group)) "col_group", "col_moment", "col_day", "col_n",
           "col_percent_registered", "col_lost")
  print(kable_tr(tb, keys, cap$tab(tr("tab_attrition", participants = participants))))
}
```

```{r performance, results='asis'}
if (has_rankings) {
  heading(tr("h_performance", options = options))
  if (nrow(PL_models$ANOVA) > 0) {
    para(tr("anova_text", k = cap$next_tab(), option = option))
    av = PL_models$ANOVA
    av[["Pr(>Chisq)"]] = format_p(av[["Pr(>Chisq)"]])
    print(kable_tr(av, c("col_trait", NA, "col_df", "col_statistic", "col_p", NA),
                   cap$tab(tr("tab_anova", options = options, option = option))))
  }
  nw = PL_models$netwinning
  if (is.data.frame(nw) && nrow(nw) > 0) {
    para(tr("favourability_text", k = cap$next_tab(), option = option, options = options))
    nw$trait[duplicated(nw$trait)] = ""
    print(kable_tr(nw, c("col_trait", "col_option", "col_n", "col_top", "col_bottom", "col_favourability"),
                   cap$tab(tr("tab_favourability", options = options)), digits = 1))
  }
  if (nrow(PL_models$kendall$kendall) > 0) {
    para(tr("kendall_text", f = cap$next_fig(), reference_trait = reference_trait,
            strong = PL_models$kendall$strongest_link[1], strong_tau = PL_models$kendall$strongest_link[2],
            weak = PL_models$kendall$weakest_link[1], weak_tau = PL_models$kendall$weakest_link[2]))
    if (isTRUE(PL_models$kendall$nboot > 0)) para(tr("kendall_boot_text", nboot = PL_models$kendall$nboot, participants = participants))
  }
}
```

```{r groups, results='asis'}
ga = group_analysis
if (isTRUE(ga$requested) && has_rankings) {
  heading(tr("h_groups"))
  para(tr("grp_intro", min_n = ga$min_n, reference_trait = reference_trait, k = cap$next_tab()))
  el = ga$eligibility
  el$share = ifelse(is.na(el$share), "", paste0(round(100 * el$share), "%"))
  el$status = vapply(el$reason, function(r) tr(paste0("grp_status_", r)), character(1))
  print(kable_tr(el[, c("group", "n_valid", "share", "status")],
                 c("col_group", "col_valid_answers", "col_share", "col_status"),
                 cap$tab(tr("tab_groups"))))

  small = ga$eligibility[ga$eligibility$reason == "too_few", ]
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(small))) {
    para(tr("grp_minority", n = small$n_valid[i], participants = participants, group = small$group[i],
            share = round(100 * small$share[i]), min_n = ga$min_n))
  }

  if (!isTRUE(ga$available)) {
    big = ga$eligibility[ga$eligibility$reason != "no_label", ][1, ]
    para(tr("grp_not_available", largest = big$group, share = round(100 * big$share),
            participants = participants))
  } else {
    if (isTRUE(ga$unbalanced)) {
      para(tr("grp_unbalanced", group = ga$smallest$group, share = round(100 * ga$smallest$share),
              k = cap$next_tab()))
    } else {
      para(tr("grp_balanced_text", k = cap$next_tab()))
    }
    print(kable_tr(ga$balanced_ranking, c("col_option", "col_worth_pooled", "col_worth_balanced",
                                          "col_rank_pooled", "col_rank_balanced"),
                   cap$tab(tr("tab_balanced", reference_trait = reference_trait)), digits = 1))

    het = ga$heterogeneity
    het$p_value = format_p(het$p_value)
    het$note = ifelse(nzchar(het$note), vapply(het$note, function(z) tr(paste0("grp_note_", z)), ""), "")
    para(tr("grp_test_text", k = cap$next_tab(), options = options))
    print(kable_tr(het, c("col_trait", "col_statistic", "col_df", "col_p", "col_note"),
                   cap$tab(tr("tab_group_test"))))

    para(tr("grp_agreement_text", k = cap$next_tab(), participant = participant))
    print(kable_tr(ga$within, c("col_group", "col_n", "col_agreement"),
                   cap$tab(tr("tab_group_agreement"))))
    if (is.data.frame(ga$between)) {
      print(kable_tr(ga$between, c("col_group", "col_group", "col_kendall"),
                     cap$tab(tr("tab_group_between"))))
    }
    if (is_plot(ga$worthmap)) para(tr("grp_worthmap_text", f = cap$next_fig(), reference_trait = reference_trait))
  }
}
```

```{r metric, results='asis', dpi=dpi, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
mt = metric
if (isTRUE(mt$available)) {
  heading(tr("h_metric"))
  para(tr("metric_intro", option = option, participant = participant))
  for (nm in names(mt$traits)) {
    x = mt$traits[[nm]]
    heading(nm, 2)
    q = x$qc
    para(tr("metric_qc", plots = q$plots, farms = q$farms, missing = q$missing_plots,
            zeros = q$zeros, outliers = q$outliers))
    if (identical(x$note, "not_enough_data")) {
      para(tr("metric_not_enough"))
      next
    }
    if (x$method == "lm") para(tr("metric_method_lm"))
    m = x$means
    cols = intersect(c("genotype", "n", "mean", "lower", "upper", "percent_of_check", "p_vs_check", "group"), names(m))
    m = m[, cols]
    if ("p_vs_check" %in% cols) m$p_vs_check = format_p(m$p_vs_check)
    keys = c(genotype = "col_option", n = "col_n", mean = "col_mean", lower = "col_lower",
             upper = "col_upper", percent_of_check = "col_percent_check", p_vs_check = "col_p_check",
             group = "col_letters")[cols]
    print(kable_tr(m, unname(keys), cap$tab(tr("tab_metric_means", option = option,
                                                check = mt$check, options = title_case(options))), digits = 2))
    v = x$variance
    if (is.data.frame(v) && nrow(v) > 0) {
      h2 = v$estimate[v$parameter == "heritability"]
      para(tr("metric_h2", h2 = round(h2, 2), options = options))
    }
    if (length(x$dropped) > 0) para(tr("metric_dropped", items = join_words(x$dropped)))
    if (is_plot(x$plots$box)) {
      cat("\n\n")
      print(x$plots$box)
      cat("\n\n", cap$fig(tr("fig_metric_box", trait = nm)), "\n\n")
    }
  }
}
```
